name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  migration-tests:
    name: Database-backed tests (PostgreSQL ${{ matrix.postgres }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - postgres: "15"
            image: postgres:15-alpine@sha256:fe0737ba566a2c5b2a28f34433c0a423261900ec17b9bf7ad115e1aae7e57f1b
          - postgres: "16"
            image: postgres:16-alpine@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
    services:
      postgres:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: moyro_migration_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: moyro_migration_test_password
          POSTGRES_DB: moyro_migration_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U moyro_migration_test -d moyro_migration_test"
          --health-interval 2s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: server/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: server/go.sum
      - name: Fetch checksum-pinned Mattermost plugin fixtures
        if: matrix.postgres == '16'
        id: plugin-fixtures
        run: |
          fixture_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/mattermost-plugin-fixtures"
          bash scripts/fetch-plugin-test-fixtures.sh "${fixture_dir}"
          echo "botman=${fixture_dir}/com.mattermost.botman-0.1.2.tar.gz" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "chatdump=${fixture_dir}/com.hkjang.mattermost-chatdump-plugin-0.5.1.tar.gz" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "echosummary=${fixture_dir}/com.mattermost.echosummary-0.6.4.tar.gz" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "langflow=${fixture_dir}/com.mattermost.langflow-0.1.20.tar.gz" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Run every database-backed test
        working-directory: server
        env:
          MOYRO_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN: postgres://moyro_migration_test:moyro_migration_test_password@127.0.0.1:5432/moyro_migration_test?sslmode=disable
          MOYRO_TEST_BOTMAN_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.plugin-fixtures.outputs.botman }}
          MOYRO_TEST_CHATDUMP_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.plugin-fixtures.outputs.chatdump }}
          MOYRO_TEST_ECHOSUMMARY_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.plugin-fixtures.outputs.echosummary }}
          MOYRO_TEST_LANGFLOW_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.plugin-fixtures.outputs.langflow }}
        run: |
          # Every package, not a hand-kept list: a database-backed test in a
          # package nobody remembered to add here would skip on every push and
          # only run at release, which is the worst place to learn about it.
          go test -race -p 1 ./...
          go vet ./...

  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: server/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: server/go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: webapp/package-lock.json
      - name: Install web dependencies
        working-directory: webapp
        run: npm ci
      - name: Enforce source-size ratchets
        run: bash scripts/check-source-sizes.sh
      - name: Audit production web dependencies
        working-directory: webapp
        run: |
          npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
          npm audit --audit-level=high
      - name: Test, type-check, and build webapp
        working-directory: webapp
        run: |
          npm test
          npm run typecheck
          npm run build
      - name: Test server
        working-directory: server
        run: |
          go test -race ./...
          go vet ./...
          go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
      - name: Test Go plugin SDK
        working-directory: plugin-sdk/go
        run: |
          go test -race ./...
          go vet ./...
      - name: Build service image
        run: |
          docker build \
            --build-arg VERSION=ci \
            --build-arg COMMIT="${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            --tag moyro:ci \
            .
      - name: Install Chromium for product-page tests
        working-directory: webapp
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Fetch browser plugin fixtures
        run: bash scripts/fetch-plugin-test-fixtures.sh "${RUNNER_TEMP}/mattermost-plugin-fixtures"
      - name: Verify routed pages, refresh, mobile layout, and browser errors
        id: product_ui
        env:
          MOYRO_E2E_PORT: "18065"
          MOYRO_PLUGIN_FIXTURE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/mattermost-plugin-fixtures
        run: |
          docker pull postgres:16-alpine@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
          bash scripts/verify-product-ui.sh moyro:ci "${RUNNER_TEMP}/moyro-screens"
      - name: Upload browser failure artifacts
        if: ${{ always() && steps.product_ui.outcome == 'failure' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ci-browser-failure-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            webapp/test-results
            ${{ runner.temp }}/moyro-screens
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Verify GitHub Pages assets and structured data
        run: node scripts/verify-pages.mjs

# Development Guide

## Prerequisites

- Go matching `server/go.mod`
- Node.js with npm available at `C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.cmd` on Windows
- Docker Desktop for PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO dev services
- PowerShell for the project verification script

## One-Command Launcher

From the repo root:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\dev.ps1
```

The launcher starts the Docker Compose dev services, then opens separate
PowerShell windows for:

- `go run ./cmd/moyro` in `server/`
- `npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173` in `webapp/`

The server window receives the same four-variable bootstrap contract used by
the release image. Values in the launcher are development-only fixtures.

Useful switches:

- `-SkipInfra` when PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO are already running
- `-NoServer` to start only infrastructure and the web app
- `-NoWeb` to start only infrastructure and the server
- `-WebPort 5174` to move Vite to another port

Before opening the server window, the launcher checks whether the requested
server port is already occupied by a process from this repo. If it finds one,
it stops that process so a stale `bin\moyro.exe` build cannot keep serving old
API routes while the web app is running fresh code.

## Local Services

```powershell
docker compose -f deploy/docker/compose.dev.yaml up -d
```

This starts:

- PostgreSQL on host port `5433`
- Redis on host port `6380`
- MinIO on host ports `9100` and `9101`

```powershell

go run ./cmd/moyro
```

Required environment variables:

- `POSTGRES_DSN`
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN`, a plain email address
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD`, 12–72 bytes

administrator console rather than additional application environment
variables.
